what: Blinded rubric scores for the 72 anonymized responses in responses/, scored against the frozen rubrics in docs/evidence-program/E15-ADDENDUM.md.
blinding: Scorers received only the anonymized response files, the scenario texts, and the rubric. The key-to-arm mapping was sealed by the dispatcher and is committed separately, after these reports.
scoring_structure: Each scorer (A and B) scored all 72 responses independently, chunked by scenario (12 chunks of 6) under identical instructions; the chunking is recorded here per the addendum's two-scorer rule as executed.
agreement: Per-criterion (360 criterion scores): exact agreement 341, differ-by-1 19, differ-by-2 0. The addendum's reconciliation pass was therefore never triggered; every criterion score is the two scorers' mean per the differ-by-at-most-1 branch.
model_note: Scorers ran as subagents of the coordinating runtime (model: Muse Wonder), as did all subjects in both arms; see RESULTS.md for the deviation record.
